About Us

A student-run consulting group that specializes in properties, brands and talents in the sports world.

Creative and Innovative Solutions.

Carolina Sports Consulting Group is a student-run consulting group that specializes in properties, brands and talents in the sports world. We offer strategic guidance, analysis and research to help our clients succeed. CSCG provides valuable hands-on professional development skills to UNC students.

Professional Development for UNC Students.

As a team of young and innovative consultants, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate the challenging and ever-evolving sports industry. Contact us today and let us help you achieve your goals!
